question: ‘Pashto’ language is spoken in which of the following neighbouring countries of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Afghanistan and Pakistan__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Pashto is an** Iranian language** spoken primarily in **Afghanistan and Pakistan**.
 
• It is **one of the two official languages of Afghanistan**, along with **Dari**.
 
• **Pashto** is also spoken by the **Pashtun diaspora** in other countries around the world.
 
• The language has a **rich literary tradition**, with **poetry and prose** dating back centuries.
 
• Pashto has its own unique script, known as the **Pashto alphabet**,
